units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:4">Ab. II, 4</cite> <he>אל … עד יום מוֹתְךָ</he> do not trust thyself (that thou wilt not sin) until thy dying day; <cite ref="Berakhot 29a">Ber. 29ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:6">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>סוף אדם לַמָּ׳</he> man’s final destiny in death; a. v. fr.—<he>מלאך המ׳</he> (abbrev. <he>מה״מ</he>) the angel of death.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:2">Gen. R. s. 9</cite> <he>והנה טוב מאד זה מה״מ</he> ‘and behold, it was very good’ (<cite ref="Genesis 1:31">Gen. I, 31</cite>) this refers to the angel of death; a. fr.
